entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It was a complete impulse buy and frankly, I just don't use it. I want a refund, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?

A preference issue? Are you deaf? I just told you I changed my mind! This is exactly the kind of runaround I expected. This is unacceptable! Get me your manager right now. I'm about to leave a review that will scorch your company's rating.
Sir, there's no need for a manager, I assure you I can resolve this for you. Let me just pull up your order and check the policy. Can I get your order number?
Ugh, fine. It's VF7229104. Just make it quick.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order was delivered eight days ago on January 10th. Let me just verify our return policy... (pause) ... Okay, great news. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside that window. I can cannot offer a refund for you right away.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... okay then. That's... good. See? That wasn't so difficult. Go ahead and process it.

Of course. I've just authorized the return. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued. And just for future reference, for items outside that window, we do have a certified resale marketplace on our website. It's a great option. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
